rv.q: Or, most likely, it’s the stellar performances and production values. Whatever the reason, this production of Frank Wildhorn’s 2004 musical is a remarkably fine mounting of a remarkably mediocre musical.
Their shows are enrapturing explosions of creativity, ingenuity and gleefully rampaging originality.

cn.t: Critics find this rock opera adaptation a gloriously atmospheric production that makes the most of its gothic setting, though the 2.5-hour runtime tests endurance in the summer heat.
